invalid_audit_time: The audit time range is invalid. Use RFC 3339 timestamps and ensure the end is after the start.
audit_event_not_found: The requested audit event was not found in this tenant. Verify the event identifier and tenant, then try again.
invalid_audit_query: The audit query is invalid. Check the tenant, filters, and pagination values.
audit_integrity_failed: Audit integrity verification failed because the event chain was altered or is incomplete. Stop relying on this export and contact an administrator.
audit_unavailable: The audit service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
audit_anchor_not_enabled: External audit anchoring is not enabled on this deployment. Enable audit.anchor in the server configuration, then retry.
audit_anchor_empty: There are no audit events to anchor for this tenant yet.
audit_anchor_already_exists: An audit anchor already exists for this head sequence. Anchors are write-once and cannot be replaced.
audit_anchor_unavailable: The external audit anchor store could not be reached. Verify the S3-compatible endpoint and credentials, then retry.
